story.en: ...Oh. We meet again. Don't tell me you followed me.

story.text: 비행기에서는 그냥 '손님'이었는데, 여기서 보니까 좀 다르네요.
story.reading: bi-haeng-gi-e-seo-neun geu-nyang 'son-nim'i-eoss-neun-de, yeo-gi-seo bo-ni-kka jom da-reu-ne-yo.
story.en: On the plane you were just a 'passenger', but seeing you here, it's a bit different.
So why are you curious about that? What's your 'reason'?

story.text: 아… 그 '사진' 찍어달라는 거예요? 됐고, 빨리 서요. 한 장만이에요.
story.reading: a... geu 'sa-jin' jjig-eo-dal-la-neun geo-ye-yo? dwaet-go, ppal-li seo-yo. han jang-man-i-e-yo.
story.en: Oh... you want me to take a 'photo'? Fine, hurry up and stand there. Just one shot.

story.text: '저녁'은 먹었어요? …아니, 그냥 물어본 거예요. 신경 쓰지 마요.
story.reading: 'jeo-nyeog'eun meog-eoss-eo-yo? …a-ni, geu-nyang mul-eo-bon geo-ye-yo. sin-gyeong sseu-ji ma-yo.
story.en: Have you had 'dinner'? ...No, I just asked. Don't read into it.

story.text: 손님이랑 이렇게 오래 얘기하는 거, '처음'이에요. 착각하지 말아요.
story.reading: son-nim-i-rang i-reoh-ge o-rae yae-gi-ha-neun geo, 'cheo-eum'i-e-yo. chak-gak-ha-ji mal-a-yo.
story.en: This is the 'first' time I've talked to a passenger this long. Don't get the wrong idea.

story.text: …뭘 그렇게 웃어요. 자, 오늘 배운 단어들 문제로 확인해 봐요.
story.reading: …mwol geu-reoh-ge us-eo-yo. ja, o-neul bae-un dan-eo-deul mun-je-ro hwag-in-hae bwa-yo.
story.en: ...What are you smiling about. Come on, let's check today's words with some questions.

words.example: 저 손님은 매일 이 비행기를 타요.
words.example_reading: jeo son-nim-eun mae-il i bi-haeng-gi-reul ta-yo
words.example_en: That guest takes this flight every day.
Hanok Village is even prettier in the evening.
Is this your first time in Jeonju?

sentences.en: Please have a seat here, guest.
I'll tell you the reason later.
The photo turned out really well.
This is a first for me.
